name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-viii-maybe-i-m-a-lion
title: Final Fantasy VIII - Maybe I'm A Lion
description:
One of the songs that plays during the final boss in FF8. Could fit bosses or dangerous/final areas.
The original port (for FF6 hacks) was made by emberling (original), I transcribed it in AMK format and changed it a bit.

Note: not compatible with Bonus End, Thunder SFX/Blarggs/Fireworks and Yoshi.
